display_transform_policy: Only deterministic coordinate placement, sorting stated per panel, log display, and color scaling; no new scientific fit, threshold, hypothesis test, or simulation.

stages.failed: A complete diffSPH solver was not executed as Stage00 truth.
stages.hypothesis: Apple Silicon CPU/MPS can support a bounded 2D proof of concept.
stages.passed: Environment/component readiness and bounded CPU/MPS execution checks.
stages.scientific_consequence: Environment readiness is not solver verification.

stages.failed: The final independent V2 spatial/shear qualification; high-resolution SPH was not established as truth.
stages.hypothesis: A fixed-physics SPH chain can be verified across implementation, conservation, reference, resolution, and independent-validation layers.
stages.passed: Structural operator repair, bounded resource policy, dense-equivalent semidiscrete reference, plateau-aware MMS requalification, evaluator and execution infrastructure.
stages.scientific_consequence: Model-form, temporal, quadrature, topology, and finite-resolution effects must be separated.

stages.failed: Static pair-force fitting v0.1 and v0.2 global train-fit gates; regularity as a hard dataset gate.
stages.hypothesis: A reciprocal conservative pair-force PIO can be structurally qualified and statically fitted.
stages.passed: Theory, target/reference hierarchy, blind dataset, and PAIR_FORCE_PIO_ARCHITECTURE_QUALIFIED.
stages.scientific_consequence: Structural correctness and representability did not imply successful static learning; the route moved to dynamic accepted-state tasks.

stages.failed: Complete multistep AD/FD qualification: 216 stable probes and 144 failures; history gradient 0/6.
stages.hypothesis: A conservative RK2 neural hybrid with short history can be implemented and multistep-gradient qualified.
stages.passed: Dynamic reference trajectories, RK2 hybrid implementation, zero-correction equivalence, checkpoint identity, one-step AD, and topology component.
stages.scientific_consequence: Correct implementation did not establish multistep trainability; task-aligned gradient diagnosis was required.

stages.failed: TASK_ALIGNED_PARAMETER_GRADIENT_NOT_QUALIFIED; raw state-loss signal was attenuated; complete parameter-coordinate FD coverage was not established.
stages.hypothesis: A local-causal raw next-state task can avoid history-gradient attenuation while preserving structure.
stages.passed: Local-causal reference-family pool, analytic/topology/DOP853 qualification, sealed role governance, nonzero correction Jacobian and structural safety.
stages.scientific_consequence: The target and scale, not only architecture Jacobians, determine detectable optimizer signals.

stages.failed: Complete coordinate-level FD qualification and local-descent route remained incomplete/not qualified.
stages.hypothesis: A D0-centered scale-aware conservative discrete-defect target restores identifiable optimization signals.
stages.passed: CONSERVATIVE_DISCRETE_DEFECT_TARGET_AND_SCALE_QUALIFIED with 384 origins; representability, scale, uncertainty, conservation and symmetry gates.
stages.scientific_consequence: The defect formulation was retained, while optimizer-path evidence was moved to actual update dynamics.

stages.failed: All D1/D2/D3 arms had 0/3 seed passes; transformer route not qualified.

stages.hypothesis: Prospective four-layer coverage selection can close consumed support and produce four fresh in-support validation lineages.
